description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with comprehensive infection prevention and control, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff. You will play a crucial part in educating our team and implementing best practices.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and delivering educational programs for nursing staff, as well as overseeing all aspects of infection prevention, surveillance, and control within the facility. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining regulatory compliance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
